story.paragraph1: For the ancient Egyptians, fragrances were sacred vehicles for the journey to the afterlife. They believed that scent had the power to transcend the physical realm.
story.paragraph2: was born from this timeless truth: fragrance is the architect of memory. A familiar scent can instantly transport you to a specific moment, place, or person.
story.paragraph3: Our mission is to help you define that essence. To design the olfactory signature that captures your soul and projects your energy, ensuring you remain unforgettable.

section1.title: 1. Data Controller
section1.content: Baura is a project developed by an individual residing in Spain. For any privacy-related inquiries, you can contact us at:

section2.title: 2. Data We Collect
section2.intro: Through this website and the Baura app we process the following data:
items: Website contact form: your name, your email and the message you send us.
App account: your email, your name and a user identifier. If you sign in with Apple or Google, we receive the email and name those services provide.

Content you create in the app: the perfumes you have tried, your ratings and notes, your longevity and sillage opinions, your wishlist, your olfactory profiles (with your test answers) and your votes on which perfumes smell alike.

Crash reports: if the app closes unexpectedly, a technical report is sent (device model, system and app versions, and where in the code the crash happened). It does not include your name or email and is not linked to your account.
App verification: a check that requests come from a genuine copy of Baura, to protect the service against abuse.
section2.community: Your ratings, your longevity and sillage opinions and your similarity votes are combined with those of other users to calculate the community rating and data shown for each perfume. Everyone can see these aggregated figures, but they never show who voted or what each person voted. Your personal notes, your wishlist and your profiles are visible only to you.
section2.noTracking: Neither the app nor this website includes advertising or behavioural analytics, and we do not track you across third-party apps or websites.
section2.camera: The app's camera search reads the perfume name on your own device: images are not stored or sent to any server.

section3.title: 3. Purpose of Processing
items: Creating and maintaining your account, and saving your collection, profiles and ratings.
Calculating the aggregated community data shown for each perfume (rating, longevity, sillage and similarities).
Sending the emails your account needs: confirming your email address and resetting your password.
Detecting and fixing app crashes and protecting the app against abuse.
Answering your enquiries and contact requests.
Complying with legal obligations where necessary.

section4.title: 4. Legal Basis
section4.content: We process your account data and the content you create in the app because they are necessary to provide the service you request when you sign up (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). Crash reports, app verification and the calculation of aggregated community data are based on our legitimate interest in the app working properly, being secure and offering useful information to all its users (Article 6(1)(f)). Contact form data is processed with your consent when you send us a message (Article 6(1)(a)).

section5.title: 5. Data Retention
section5.content: We keep your account data for as long as your account is active. You can delete it at any time from the app: your account, collection, profiles and votes are deleted, and the aggregated community data is recalculated without them. Crash reports are kept for a maximum of 90 days. Contact data is deleted 12 months after the last communication.

section6.title: 6. Data Sharing
section6.intro: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. Your data is processed only by the following, on our behalf or where required by law:
items: Google (Firebase and Google Cloud): hosts the app's accounts and data (Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore), receives crash reports (Firebase Crashlytics), verifies the app (Firebase App Check, with Apple App Attest), sends account emails and serves perfume images (Google Cloud Storage).
Apple and Google, if you sign in with them, under their own privacy policies.
EmailJS, which delivers the messages from this website's contact form.
Public authorities, where required by law.
section6.transfers: The app's database is hosted on servers in the European Union (Madrid). Some of these providers may process data outside the European Economic Area; in that case, transfers are covered by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or by the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.

section7.title: 7. Your Rights
section7.intro: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to:
section7.item1: Access: Know what data we have about you.
section7.item3: Erasure: Request the deletion of your data.
section7.item4: Portability: Receive your data in a structured format.
section7.item5: Objection: Object to the processing of your data.
section7.outro: To exercise these rights, write to us at
section7.responseTime: We will respond within a maximum of 30 days.
section7.inApp: From the app itself you can download all your data (Settings → Account Management → Export My Data) and delete your account (Settings → Account Management → Delete Account).

section8.title: 8. Security
section8.content: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or alteration. However, no system is completely secure and we cannot guarantee the absolute security of information.

section9.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
section9.content: We may update this policy occasionally. We will notify you of significant changes through the application or by email. We recommend reviewing this page periodically.

section10.title: 10. Contact and Complaints
section10.claimIntro: If you believe your rights have not been properly addressed, you can file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD):

section1.content: By accessing and using the Baura application and this website, you accept these terms of use. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our services.

section2.title: 2. Service Description
section2.intro: Baura is a free application that helps you discover and organize fragrances. The service includes:
section2.item1: Personalized perfume recommendations based on your preferences.
section2.item2: Management of your personal fragrance collection.
section2.item3: Information about olfactory families and notes.
section2.item4: Tools to explore the world of perfumery.

section3.title: 3. Project Nature
section3.content: Baura is a personal project developed by an individual in Spain. It is not a company or commercial entity. The application is offered free of charge and non-profit, as a tool for perfumery enthusiasts.

section4.title: 4. Permitted Use
section4.intro: You agree to use Baura responsibly and legally. The following is prohibited:

section4.item2: Attempting to access unauthorized systems or data.
section4.item3: Copying, modifying or distributing content without authorization.
section4.item4: Introducing viruses, malware or malicious code.
section4.item5: Interfering with the normal operation of the service.

section5.title: 5. Content and Recommendations
section5.paragraph1: Fragrance recommendations are automatically generated based on your preferences and algorithms. They are indicative and do not constitute professional advice.
section5.paragraph2: Information about perfumes (notes, families, etc.) is collected from public sources and may contain inaccuracies. We do not guarantee the complete accuracy of this data.

section6.title: 6. Intellectual Property

Their use in this application is solely for identification and reference purposes. Baura is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by any of the mentioned perfume brands.
section6.paragraph2: The design, code and original content of Baura are protected by copyright.
